quilt-ml-recipes-main/README.md:
# quilt-ml-recipes

**Recipes that work.** The night's working setups, consolidated: receipted,
negative-controlled, growable ML / RL / judge / convergence setups in the quilt idiom.
Node >= 18, zero dependencies, ESM.

## The doctrine

> **A recipe enters this library only with a receipt, a negative control, and a grow
> path. If you cannot falsify it, it is not a recipe.**

Three documents per recipe, each load-bearing:

- **RECEIPT.md** — what ran, what returned (real numbers from a real run on this
  checkout), and what counts as failure. A recipe without pinned numbers is a rumor.
- **NEGATIVE-CONTROL.md** — the rule's OWN failure mode, demonstrated live. A claim
  that cannot be shown failing is not a claim, it is a vibe. Every failure mode in
  this library has been run and measured, not imagined.
- **GROW.md** — how this state scales toward a real application. States that only
  demo are toys; these states are grown for building from.

And two mechanical guarantees:

- **Self-contained**: each `index.mjs` is zero-dep and copy-anywhere. Recipes are
  copied/adapted code, NOT import-path dependencies on their lineage repos — the pin
  travels with the recipe card.
- **Certified, not trusted**: `node lib/verify.mjs` runs every recipe's assertions and
  prints the table. `LIBRARY CERTIFIED` or nothing. The certifier itself has a
  negative control: a deliberately-broken fixture (test/test-fixtures/broken-recipe)
  must be REFUSED, or the gate is broken.

## Quickstart

```sh
node lib/verify.mjs                 # the library's own receipt: recipe | assertion | actual | verdict
node --test test/*.test.mjs         # 8 tests: T-R1..T-R6 + T-LIB + NC-LIB

node recipes/r1-deterministic-cell-regression/index.mjs                     # run one recipe
node recipes/r1-deterministic-cell-regression/index.mjs --negative-control  # watch its rule fail on purpose
```

## The six recipes

| # | recipe | one-line rule |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | deterministic-cell-regression | same seed ⇒ byte-identical metrics, pinned by trajectory sha and the quilt-lab sealed metrics sha |
| R2 | cellgraph-mlp-training | a neural net is a JSON cell graph; training is receipted per epoch and deterministic per seed |
| R3 | receipt-chained-run-ledger | a run isn't done until it's sealed; the chain proves integrity, the anchor proves completeness |
| R4 | judge-calibration-battery | a judge counts only if its predictions survive the shuffle; Brier alone certifies ignorance |
| R5 | convergence-alarm | "converged" is a shape claim: flatTail ≥ k certifies, a moving series is never certified |
| R6 | sheet-convergence-diff-dag | replicas converge because the fold is a pure function of the DAG — not because messages arrived |

Full map (what each proves, lineage, grow path): [INDEX.md](INDEX.md).

## Lineage

Everything here shipped and test-verified the same night in the SuperInstance fleet:

- **SuperInstance/quilt-lab** (67-b) — the experiment protocol: register → run →
  receipt → seal. R1's worked example and R3's ledger discipline.
- **SuperInstance/quilt-nn** (67-d) — neural nets as quilt cell graphs with per-epoch
  receipt chains. R2's graph, train loop and XOR pin (tip `fcb51c678c75…` reproduced
  byte-exact here from copied code).
- **SuperInstance/typesafe-quilts** (67-c) — the System One judge lane: calibration
  battery, Brier/NC-CAL scoring, JUDGE-PROTOCOL.md. R4's scoring machinery and gate.
- **SuperInstance/quilt-neighbourhood** (66-a) — content-addressed CellDiff DAG,
  registered P1–P4 merge policy, receipt chains. R6's fold and integrity gate.
- **study/w67-delta-shape** (wave-67) — deltas-as-shape: flatTail/changePoints/shapeHash.
  R5's predicates.

The recipe card idiom is the point: a recipe keeps its lineage's guarantees while
cutting the dependency. Both cross-repo byte-pins (R1's `7b7364d3ccfe…`, R2's
`fcb51c678c75…`) are evidence that copying the code copies the truth.

## Repository layout

```
lib/verify.mjs          the certifier — one entry point, one table
recipes/r1..r6/         spec.json + index.mjs + RECEIPT.md + NEGATIVE-CONTROL.md + GROW.md
test/*.test.mjs         T-R1..T-R6 (one per recipe) + T-LIB + NC-LIB
test/test-fixtures/     broken-recipe/ — the certifier's negative control
INDEX.md                the library map
TEST-RECEIPT.md         the release's own verification receipt
```

## Honest limits (library-level)

- Byte-pins bind to this arithmetic (V8 floats, fixed reduction order, canonical
  rounding). Different engines can drift; the failure conditions, not the pins, are
  the portable contract.
- The mock judge in R4 is labeled MOCK and must stay offline; live judging needs the
  lineage repo's budget + receipt protocol.
- A bare hash chain (R3) cannot detect tail truncation; anchoring discipline is part
  of the recipe, not an optional extra.
- 6 recipes is a floor, not a ceiling — but the doctrine is the admission gate: no
  receipt, no negative control, no grow path, no entry.
